content: NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed env vars are inlined into the client JS bundle at next build time, not a runtime secret. Vercel allows up to 64KB total env-var payload per deployment; Edge Functions and Middleware are limited to 5KB per var, irrelevant since this project has no functions. No official Vercel bundle-size hard limit found specific to client WebGL apps; the real risk is client JS weight from three.js, shaders, and charting, mitigated via per-file addon imports and avoiding unnecessary code-splitting.
